note: Wooded hills east of the Nodaway River off I-29 at Fillmore. The main campground is on the gravel road in from County Road 405, with gravel pads, tables and fire rings on both sides of the road and a privy at the lot beside it; six more primitive camping spots sit at parking lots around the area, three of them on the gravel road along the river. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: page 'Camping: Individual Campsites', Rule 140 standard; map (07/07) a hatched 'Campground' + privy and six 'Primitive Camping Area' lots; brochure 'Primitive camping is permitted only in areas identified on area map'. Free/FCFS/no hookups/14 nights now manual, privy added. Pin is a small river-end lot under canopy - move 2 km E to the main campground (GIS 131). Not waterfront kept. Phone matches.
flags: PIN (important): stored 39.95164,-94.99076 = GIS 126, the northernmost of three small lots on the gravel road along the Nodaway River, under canopy at the end of a lane. The area's clear main camp is the map's hatched 'Campground' (privy, accessible symbol) between the A18 and A1 trail lots, GIS 131 at 39.95190,-94.96746: imagery shows ~10 gravel pads with tables/fire rings on both sides of the gravel road on a mowed opening. Move the pin to 39.95195,-94.96720 (~2.0 km E).

INCLUSION/FIT: area page 'Things to Do When You Visit: Camping: Individual Campsites'; Rule 140 standard text, no permit rule, no Rule 101. Brochure: 'Primitive camping is permitted only in areas identified on area map.' 'Motor vehicles are restricted to roadways and parking areas.' Main campground pads are short (~8-10 m) gravel pull-offs beside a gravel road with mowed grass around them - a 23-ft rig can pull off at them. Horseback riding is allowed on the multi-use trails but MDC marks no horse camp - nothing to separate.

CLUSTERS: 7 GIS camping points - the main campground (131), the A15 trail lot (~500 m NW of it), the SE lot off CR 405 (132, ~640 m S), the south lot off CR 403 (130) and three lots on the river road (126-129, 1-2 km W). The river lots are a separate gravel road from the south (CR 404) about 2 km from the main campground, but each is a single small lot - not proposed as a split. near.py: nothing else within 3 km.
WATERFRONT (not waterfront, kept): the main campground is on the uplands ~2 km from the Nodaway; the river lots sit behind wooded banks.
Season (manual, year-round) left as stored. 2027 MDC permit is in the policy row (not written per entry).
